about: Every asset the studio may use, with what it is and whether it may be published. Paths are relative to studio/. status: approved (use it), review (a person confirms rights, consent or quality first), rejected (never; the reason says why). Recipes that use an asset outside this list get a warning; rejected ones stop the render.
